Name: Just Saying Hi - Continuation
Author: anhelinabalerina
Description:
This mod is a continuation of the original mod ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37870]Just Saying Hi[/url] by Sable17.

[b]If you are tired of constantly having to pursue each townie just to greet them, then this mod is for you![/b] Aside from the base game NPCs, the continuation also includes townies from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] made by FlashShifter. Future updates may also add NPCs from Ridgeside Village and other mods, as well as custom NPCs.

[u]How to install:
[/u]1. Go to the original page and download the mod.
2. Download the continuation.
3. Replace the [i]default.json[/i] file from the original folder with the [i]default.json[/i] from the continuation folder.
4. You are good to play now!

[u]GitHub:[/u] [url=https://github.com/CodingDilettante/Just-Saying-Hi-Continuation]https://github.com/CodingDilettante/Just-Saying-Hi-Continuation

[/url]If you see any errors, whether technical or grammatical, or have suggestions, feel free to point them out in the comments!

All credits go to the creators of the original mods. Permissions were granted.
